# Mackenzie Apartments Mombasa

> Furnished waterfront apartments for long-term rent, set in tropical gardens on Tudor Creek, by Nyali Bridge, Mombasa, Kenya. Studios, one, two and three-bedroom apartments in a private gated community with two swimming pools, a gym and a private jetty. Owner-managed by the Mackenzie family for over 30 years.

## Key facts

- Location: Ras Kisauni Road, by Nyali Bridge, Mombasa, Kenya (Nyali side of the bridge, on Tudor Creek)
- Apartments: studio, 1 bedroom, 2 bedroom and one 3 bedroom; all fully furnished, all bedrooms en-suite, equipped kitchen, air conditioning and ceiling fans, Wi-Fi
- Renting: long-term rentals. Pricing and availability are shared on request
- On site: two swimming pools, residents' gym, decks by the water, private jetty and boat moorings, tropical gardens, covered parking
- Security and services: gated compound, 24-hour security, standby generators, own fresh-water supply, on-site management, owners living on site
- Marina: pontoon moorings for boats up to 30 ft, open to residents and to outside boat owners
- Nearby by car: China Square 4 min, Nyali Cinemax 5 min, The Mombasa Hospital 11 min, Aga Khan Academy 11 min, Old Town and Fort Jesus 12 min, Nyali Golf and Country Club 12 min, Nyali Beach 14 min, Moi International Airport 20 min, SGR station 25 min
- Contact: WhatsApp +254 700 932 020, email dempoffice@gmail.com, Instagram @mackenzieapartmentsmombasa
